assumptions.claim: External entropy source must respond to entropy_req_o by asserting entropy_ack_i and providing valid entropy_i.
assumptions.risk: Stale or invalid entropy may be used for PRNG reseeding, weakening mask entropy.

assumptions.claim: External reseed requester must hold reseed_req_i asserted until reseed_ack_o is asserted to complete the reseed operation.
assumptions.risk: Premature deassertion may cause incomplete reseeding, leaving PRNG state partially updated.

assumptions.claim: Consumer of data_o must sample the value only when data_update_i indicates a valid update.
assumptions.risk: Sampling data_o at an arbitrary time may read inconsistent or stale mask values.

assumptions.claim: force_masks_i must be asserted only when it is safe to override automatically generated masks, and must be deasserted to restore normal PRNG-driven masks.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect usage could expose predictable masks or compromise masking security.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni (active-low) must be asserted for at least one full clock cycle to initialize internal PRNG state before any entropy or reseed operations begin.
assumptions.cond: At power-up or after a reset event
assumptions.risk: Uninitialized state could produce predictable initial masks, breaking side-channel resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: The internal logic that uses force_masks_i is not visible; it is possible that asserting force_masks_i could trivially override masks including secure ones if not gated by a secure state machine.
uncertain_points.risk: Unauthorized forcing of masks could expose secret data or allow predictable operation.

uncertain_points.claim: The precise timing relationship between entropy_ack_i and entropy_i validity is not defined; it is unclear if entropy_i must be held stable after entropy_req_o until entropy_ack_i, or can change.
uncertain_points.risk: If entropy_i is not correctly sampled, the PRNG reseed may use a partial or incorrect entropy word.

uncertain_points.claim: After reseed_ack_o is asserted, the hold time required on reseed_req_i before deassertion is unknown; deasserting too early might truncate the reseed sequence.
uncertain_points.risk: Partial reseed could leave the PRNG state in a weak or predictable condition.
